setup.intro: Pick who's playing, then hand each of them a deck.
setup.seatHint: Seat players and assign their decks to start.
setup.tip: Anyone at the table can lend a deck. Borrowed decks count toward the borrower's record, not the owner's.

playerSheet.everyoneSeated: Everyone in {pod} is already at the table.
playerSheet.guestExplain: Guests don't join your playgroup — they're just at the table for this game. Their record won't affect pod standings.

deckSheet.intro: Anyone in the pod can lend a deck, even if they're not at the table. Decks not owned by {name} are marked {borrowed}.
deckSheet.empty: No decks in this pod yet. Import one under Decks and it shows up here.
deckSheet.loadError: Couldn't load the pod's decks. Reload the page to try again.

tracker.playerDiedSub: Use when life math is off
tracker.concedeSub: Drop out, keep the game going

menu.title: Game menu
menu.subtitle: Manage the table from here.
menu.endGameAlive: {n} players still alive — eliminate them first
menu.endGameReady: Lock the winner and log the game
menu.retireGameSub: Save what you tracked, log it with no winner. Counts toward games played.
menu.cancelGameSub: Toss this game. Won't go on anyone's record.
menu.artVia: Art via Scryfall. Cards © Wizards of the Coast.

manualDeath.title: {name} — eliminated?
manualDeath.subtitle: Use this when something off-grid kills them: a player effect, life-set-to-0 spell, conceded mid-pile. Their life total stays as-is.
manualDeath.logsTime: Logs the time as {time} and freezes their tile. The pod plays on.

cmdrDmg.title: Commander damage on {name}
cmdrDmg.subtitle: 21 from a single commander ends the game for them. Track each attacker separately.

concede.title: {name} — concede
concede.subtitle: Drops out of the game. Logged as a loss, but the game keeps going for everyone else.

retire.title: Retire this game?
retire.subtitle: Save what you tracked so far, but log it with no winner. Decks won't get a win or loss — it still counts toward games played.

stall.label: Long stall
stall.sub: No one can close it out

other.label: Other
other.sub: Add a note when you log it

cancel.title: Cancel this game?
cancel.subtitle: Throws out everything tracked so far. The game won't go into the pod's record.

other.label: Other
other.sub: Add a note when you log it

survey.title: Survey
survey.funQuestion: How much fun did you have?

recap.deleteConfirmBody: This permanently removes the game and all survey responses.
